This suggests a potential role in modulating immune responses, as macrophage scavenger receptors are involved in antigen presentation and phagocytosis. The second pathway, involving DNA polymerase eta and 12-Hydroxy Simonellite, indicates a broader involvement in cellular processes, possibly related to DNA repair and replication. The integration of these targets highlights a complex network of interactions, where Heitziamide B may influence multiple cellular functions through different mechanisms. The evidence supports a mechanistic link between Heitziamide B and Lysine-specific demethylase 2A, though the exact functional significance of these interactions remains to be fully elucidated.
